enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Hotkey and re-applying your version on startup. The buttons below always work.

openMenu.name: ViaFabricPlus menu
openMenu.description: The main ViaFabricPlus screen: pick your protocol version (Release, Beta, Alpha, Classic, April Fools, Bedrock, favorites, search).

openSettings.name: ViaFabricPlus settings
openSettings.description: All ViaFabricPlus settings tabs: General, Bedrock, Authentication, Visual, Debug.

openClassiCube.name: ClassiCube server list
openClassiCube.description: Browse and join ClassiCube servers (asks you to log in first). Not available while connected to a server.

openBetaCraft.name: BetaCraft server list
openBetaCraft.description: Browse and join BetaCraft servers. Not available while connected to a server.

targetVersion.name: Target version
targetVersion.description: Type a version (1.8.9, 1.12.2, 1.21.x, b1.7.3, c0.30, auto, native) and press Apply. Always shows the version ViaFabricPlus is using right now.

resetVersion.name: Reset to native version
resetVersion.description: Use the version of your Minecraft client (no protocol translation).

openMenuKey.name: Hotkey: open ViaFabricPlus menu
openMenuKey.description: Press this key on any screen to open the ViaFabricPlus menu.

applyOnStartup.name: Re-apply version on startup
applyOnStartup.description: Apply the version above every time the game starts.

notifications.name: Show notifications
notifications.description: Show a notification when the version changes.
